headline: Third straight quiet day; the board stays still
body: A third quiet day in a row with no scored events. Reversion, the ending where humanity turns away from technology, drifted down a hundredth of a point as earlier backlash stories faded. Everything else held. Horizon Balance remains at 1.9, unchanged.
movers_note: No ending moved by 0.1 or more; Reversion eased slightly (-0.0) as older news faded.
